summary: +3 to attack and damage rolls; while held you breathe water, swim and fly 30 feet, and it glows like a lantern.
text: You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon. While you hold it you can breathe underwater and have Swim and Fly Speeds of 30 feet, and it sheds Bright Light in a 5-foot radius and Dim Light for 5 feet beyond. As a Magic action you can make up to a gallon of liquid it touches as salty as seawater.

params.text: turns up to a gallon of touched water as briny as the sea

powers.text: Magic action: up to a gallon of liquid you touch with it turns salty. (No other effect in the game.)
